title: Sample: French, France vs Switzerland
description: A few everyday words that mean different things in France and in French-speaking Switzerland.

items.context: On prend le [déjeuner] à sept heures.
items.contextTranslation: We have breakfast (CH) / lunch (FR) at seven.

items.context: Vous voulez un [cornet] pour vos courses ?

items.note: In Switzerland « un linge » on its own is usually a towel.

items.context: Les fraises sont en [action] cette semaine.

meaning.ch: to put away, tidy up; to reduce

items.note: Regional (Vaud, Fribourg): « réduis tes affaires » = put your things away.
Swiss word; in France: la serpillière.
Swiss word; in France: le pourboire.
Swiss and Belgian; in France: soixante-dix.
